GracePrinciples.Principle: Contract-first changes: clarify scope and verification before implementation.
Keep semantic anchors stable and grep-friendly.
Use assertions, scopes, and tests as fresh completion evidence.
Graph-anchored work: modules, flows, and verification entries live in .grace and stay aligned with the code they describe.
Mirror discipline: every change under skills/grace/* is copied to plugins/grace/skills/grace/* in the same commit.
Skill documentation keeps the three-section discipline (Common Rationalizations, When NOT to Use, Verification).
Deterministic verification first: Bun test suites for CLI modules and pure-function tests for helpers before any manual smoke evidence.
